title: Hand Focus
description: Keeps tracked hands clear while softly blurring the surrounding image.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Strength of the blur outside tracked hands.

parameters.label: Hand Area
parameters.description: Size of the clear area around each tracked hand.

parameters.label: Edge Softness
parameters.description: Softness around the clear hand area.

parameters.label: Trail Focus
parameters.description: How strongly recent hand motion remains in focus.

parameters.label: Desaturate
parameters.description: Colour removed from the blurred background.

parameters.label: Outline
parameters.description: Brightness of the tracked hand outline.

parameters.label: Outline Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the tracked hand outline.
